messages:
emily_support: escalated ticket from customer (acct: acme) — intermittent JSON parse errors from TS SDK streaming mode when the auth token refreshes mid-stream. They see 'Unexpected token' and our billing spikes. req_id=rcq-42a9

raj_sre: can you paste the raw capture and sdk version? also their node version and whether they're using the reconnect/refresh hook

emily_support: node 18, @redwood/sdk-js 0.14.2, json_mode: true, using our token refresh middleware (auto-refresh on 401). raw capture attached (excerpt):

<raw stream>
{"id":"tok-1","delta":{"text":"hello"}}
{"id":"tok-2","delta":{"text":"world"}}}{"id":"tok-3","delta":{"text":"!"}}
</raw stream>

errors: "Unexpected token { in JSON at position 0" from customer's parser. they said it started after a spike in 401s and retries.

sam_ts_sdk: that snippet is golden — you can see two JSON objects were concatenated without a newline between them: "}{{" -> "}{". our NDJSON streaming parser assumes newline-delimited objects. when the client refresh/retry reopens the stream we currently append frames without ensuring a delimiter. this looks like the retry layer is re-emitting the tail of previous frame immediately followed by the new frame start.

maria_engineer: ack. Likely places: (1) sdk request retry wrapper that replays buffered tail, (2) runtime gateway that stitches connections during auth handoff. both can cause interleaved frames.

raj_sre: can we reproduce locally? emily, ask customer for a pcap or raw tcp dump. Also please capture the exact Authorization sequence (401 -> refresh -> 200) timestamps.

emily_support: asked for pcap, they provided a tiny raw dump. attaching sanitized snippet above. customer agrees to try a client-side workaround while we investigate.

sam_ts_sdk: quick mitigation to ship to customer: treat a direct '}{' boundary as a separator before passing to the NDJSON parser. small patch:

```ts
// naive sanitizer before feeding parser
function sanitizeStreamChunk(chunk: string) {
  return chunk.replace(/}\{(?=\\S)/g, '}\n{');
}
```

This will handle the most common concatenation case without large refactor. Not ideal but low-risk for a hotfix.

maria_engineer: thanks. We should also add logging when we detect re-join during active stream to make root-cause clearer. I'll open a runtime ticket to audit gateway reconnection behavior (RT-451).

raj_sre: let's gate the client fix behind a short test: simulate token expiry mid-stream and ensure we don't lose object boundaries. Sam, can you add a unit test that replays the exact sequence?

sam_ts_sdk: on it. I'll add test + hotfix branch and tag emily for patch build. will include a note that this only applies to json_mode streaming with auto-refresh enabled.

deploy-bot: Canary window: 2026-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. flagged: low-risk client hotfix.

emily_support: sending customer the sanitizer patch and temporary instructions. I created internal incident INC-1234 and linked logs. will update once they confirm. :thumbsup:

maria_engineer: also adding a small FAQ note — "If you see 'Unexpected token' during streaming after auth refresh, upgrade to patched sdk or use server-side newline normalization."

raj_sre: good. keep me posted if customer still sees billing anomalies after fix.

emily_support: will do. thanks everyone.
